lines.beaver: 와, 민지야! 오랜만이다. 너 좀 달라 보인다?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, Minji! Long time no see. You look kind of different?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, minjiya! oraenmanida. neo jom dalla boinda?
lines.learner: 지호야, 진짜 오랜만이야! 나 많이 달라졌어?
lines.en: Jiho, it's really been a while! Have I changed a lot?
lines.roman: Jihoya, jinjja oraenmaniya! na mani dallajyeosseo?

lines.beaver: 응, 머리가 완전 달라졌네. 어디서 했어?
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, your hair is totally different. Where did you get it done?
lines.beaver_roman: Eung, meoriga wanjeon dallajyeonne. eodiseo haesseo?
lines.en: I cut it short at the hair salon near my house.

lines.beaver: 잘 어울린다. 드라이도 하고 온 거야?
lines.beaver_en: It suits you. Did you blow-dry it too?
lines.beaver_roman: Jal eoullinda. deuraido hago on geoya?
lines.en: Yeah, after blow-drying it this morning, it looked nice.

lines.beaver_en: Your face looks good too. Your skin got clearer.
lines.learner: 전엔 여드름 때문에 얼굴이 자주 빨개졌거든.
lines.en: Before, my face often turned red because of acne.
lines.roman: Jeonen yeodeureum ttaemune eolguri jaju ppalgaejyeotgeodeun.

lines.beaver_en: I see. I can't see any now, though.
lines.en: As I kept going to a dermatologist, it got much better.

lines.beaver: 화장도 바꿨어? 눈이 더 커 보여.
lines.beaver_en: Did you change your makeup too? Your eyes look bigger.
lines.beaver_roman: Hwajangdo bakkwosseo? nuni deo keo boyeo.
lines.learner: 응, 화장은 연하게 하고 눈가만 진하게 했어.
lines.en: Yeah, I kept my makeup light and only darkened around my eyes.
lines.roman: Eung, hwajangeun yeonhage hago nunkkaman jinhage haesseo.

lines.beaver: 그래서 그런지 얼굴이 더 밝아 보여.
lines.beaver_en: Maybe that's why your face looks brighter.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraeseo geureonji eolguri deo balga boyeo.
lines.en: Thanks. My face used to be a bit chubby, remember?

lines.beaver: 어느새 살이 그렇게 빠졌어? 내내 바빴잖아.
lines.beaver_en: When did you lose so much weight? You were busy the whole time.
lines.beaver_roman: Eoneusae sari geureoke ppajyeosseo? naenae bappatjana.
lines.en: I started walking for exercise, and I lost weight.

lines.beaver_en: Now that your looks changed, do you feel different too?
lines.en: Yeah, I feel brighter and more confident too.

lines.beaver: 정말 보기 좋다. 커피 마시면서 더 얘기하자!
lines.beaver_en: You look really good. Let's talk more over coffee!
lines.beaver_roman: Jeongmal bogi jota. keopi masimyeonseo deo yaegihaja!
lines.en: Sure! I'll treat you today. Let's go!
